span.p: Why NonProdDR Group Makes Tier 3 Quota-Neutral

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
WITHOUT Group:
Reduce NonProd CR → releases to NonProd sub ledger
Increase DR CR → separate DR sub ledger
Risk: quota throttle or approval delay (hours)
WITH NonProdDR Group:
Reduce NonProd CR → back to SHARED GROUP POOL
Increase DR CR → from SAME GROUP POOL
RTO gated only by ARM propagation (minutes)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
potential_dr_demand(region)
= Σ prod_allocated for all customers
where dr_region = this_region

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Combined crisis capacity:
DR CRG (40%) + Headroom (30%) = 70%
of Prod demand
Remaining 30% → Tier 3

max_emergency_transfer_qty
× vCPU_per_instance
Pre-staged — always consumed

span.p:
Group Limit
= Prod_CRG_qty × vCPU × 1.20
(20% growth buffer)

span.p:
Members: Provider Subscription only
Isolation: HARD — NonProd/DR cannot consume

span.p:
HC-7 ENFORCEMENT
Engine blocks NonProd expansion if:
nprod_quota_used + new_qty×vCPU
> effective_nonprod_ceiling

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DR FLOOR
DR_FLOOR_VCPU =
potential_dr_demand × dr_ratio_max × vCPU
Engine-enforced sub-limit
(Azure has no native sub-reservations)
